entries.title: 0004 — Plaintext Residue Policy

entries.title: 0005 — Vault Encryption Stack Doctrine
entries.role: Fixes vault cryptography doctrine: no custom cryptography; authenticated encryption only; memory-hard key derivation; versioned format with escrow-free user-side migration; keychain integration deferred; final library selection deferred to spike evidence.

entries.title: 0006 — Runtime / Platform Stack Doctrine
entries.role: Fixes platform doctrine and the evaluation spike plan: verifiably telemetry-silent by observation, no background processes, user-initiated updates, accessibility as scored criterion; spike disposable and outside the repo with output hygiene rules; stack selection deferred to a final-selection record with evidence attached.

entries.title: 0007 — Development-Artifact Policy
entries.role: Fixes development-artifact law from the first runnable artifact: synthetic-only everywhere including local debugging; paste-is-publication; spike output hygiene with no machine-identifying detail beyond OS class; spike artifacts never become product artifacts; crash and debug artifacts local and human-shared only.

entries.title: 0008 — Runtime Stack — Final Selection
entries.role: Selects the engine spine's runtime and crypto binding on first-pass spike evidence: the local-process class (Python 3 with the PyNaCl libsodium binding); rejects the bundled-runtime class for the spine while leaving future surface reconsideration open; defers the native-shell class to the review-package phase; states Windows-class single-OS sufficiency for spine selection; binds the key-handling caveat and its W3-D2 mitigations; the first binding installation remains a future fence-crossing not authorised by this record.

entries.title: 0009 — Import File Boundary
entries.role: Fixes the import boundary (edge E1): bytes plus user-supplied provenance only; zero content interpretation at import; integrity inspection capped at type verification; provisional v1 format list hardening at the engine brief; anything beyond the boundary is processing under grant.

entries.title: 0010 — Minimal Review Posture
entries.role: Fixes the minimal review posture: tests simulate review via structurally unreachable doubles; nothing real becomes Approved before real review surfaces exist; the early caller supports rights-operation categories with review/approve explicitly excluded; no Approved-status item in any non-test store; reversal only by new record.

entries.title: 0011 — Local Backup Guidance
entries.role: Fixes the backup story without escrow: ciphertext backup may travel anywhere, the key travels nowhere; one-action encrypted export with symmetric user-performed restore; offered once beside the key-loss sentence, one restatement on skip, never nagged; no Wing-operated destination, no automatic backup, no background sync; recovery codes deferred to their own record.

entries.title: 0012 — Key-Loss Onboarding Wording
entries.role: Fixes the vetted key-loss sentence (the Wing's own inability named explicitly) and its doctrine: before vault creation, one deliberate acknowledgment, plain-not-frightening and never softened into false reassurance; said once then discoverable, never pushed; wording governed because the meaning is the wording; completion-rate concerns never drive softer language.

entries.title: 0013 — Key Derivation, Custody, and Envelope Selection
entries.role: Closes ADR 0005 named opens and fixes the v1 key architecture: moderate KDF profile as evidence-based review-dated provisional (named profiles only, parameters and salt recorded in the versioned key envelope); passphrase-alone custody with no escrow or recovery path in any form; two-layer wrap (records under a random master key, passphrase-derived key seals only the master); per-record sealed envelopes with cardinality/size leakage named for the threat register; the sealed key envelope travels with backups as ciphertext, restore requiring the passphrase; envelope resides in its own small versioned file. Authorises no implementation.

entries.title: 0014 — Licence Selection
entries.role: Selects the Apache License 2.0 for v1, standard and unmodified, with the public repository owner as copyright holder: broad reuse (commercial and closed-source included) is intentional; copyleft rejected as mission-fit not principle; custom and moral-use licensing rejected firmly; NOTICE is an informational redistribution notice carrying the copyright line, fork non-endorsement, and public-safety boundary statements without adding licence terms; governance intent lives in documentation; forks inherit code, never endorsement or certification. Project-level decision, not an engine-track deliverable.

entries.title: 0015 — Durable Ledger Doctrine
entries.role: Decides that the durable ledger exists and how: sealed under the master-key custody boundary because governance metadata is privacy-sensitive by pattern; independently sealed append frames as the doctrine direction; event scope doctrine-wide with v1 implementation limited to existing transition events (import/custody emission a named future extension, not mandated); the ledger joins the backup unit as sealed ciphertext; erasure is the user knowing act only, whole-ledger in v1, never a side effect of profile erasure; append-only with torn-tail one-event blast radius honestly stated. Sequences a small dedicated implementation milestone before the D6 brief. Authorises no implementation.

entries.title: 0016 — Room Contract Template
entries.role: Fixes the room-contract template: eleven required sections in fixed order and numbering, each present and non-blank, 'not applicable' written with a reason, a mandatory eleventh open-questions section reading 'None at acceptance.' when empty, and the Meditation reads-nothing case as the worked N/A example (no bespoke exception). Decides the skeleton only; fills no room's sections. Gates the four room contracts (W4-D2 through W4-D5) and the contract-conformance validator (W4-D6). Wording sections route to the future W6 governed string catalogue as review-of-record. Authorises no scaffolding and no implementation.

entries.title: 0017 — Room Isolation Model
entries.role: Sets the room-isolation standard that fills every room contract's Processing Boundary section: architectural isolation as doctrine — each room's processing interaction occurs in a context that has never contained another room's content; one processing grant binds exactly one room and the context derives from the grant; no interface accepts content from two rooms; cross-room content is unreachable, not merely forbidden; filtering or output controls alone are insufficient; grant scoping and isolation are separate complementary walls; W5 must later realise the property while W4 specifies no mechanism; behavioural evaluations still apply; any future exception requires its own accepted record with fixed minimum contents and no silent downgrade to policy isolation; the Meditation Room receives the uniform standard while its no-outward-signal property is left to DR-W4-04. The display-vs-processing-context split and per-room context-cost evidence are deferred to W5. Authorises no implementation.

entries.title: 0018 — Read/Write Scope Confirmation
entries.role: Confirms W1-D1 as the sole source of truth for every room's read and write scope and fixes the fidelity mechanism: contracts carry scope only through the paired form — an exact W1-D1 reference (record, section, edge/scope id) as controlling authority plus a complete verbatim quotation (punctuation and qualifiers preserved) for legibility; a quotation/reference mismatch fails review; paraphrase is prohibited; the source-backed blur-word set (generally, such as, including, including but not limited to) and the broader anti-drift rule bind within scope clauses; scope amendments land in W1-D1 first and contracts follow, never lead; absence of a D1 edge means absence of authority and consent cannot create an absent edge; rooms write only their own authorised record classes with the D3-T3 label-on-entry by reference; no room writes into another room's jurisdiction. Records that direct reading of live W1-D1 exposed wording drift in the W4 pack and runway summaries — D1 wins, those are planning materials not scope authority. Fills ADR 0016's Read/Write Scope slots; complementary to ADR 0017's isolation. Confirms and transmits scope, mints none. Authorises no implementation.

entries.title: 0019 — Cross-Room Inference Prohibition Standard
entries.role: Makes Law 8's cross-room/out-of-scope inference prohibition operational and evaluable: a room must not derive a health-relevant or room-jurisdiction conclusion outside its granted context (constitutional prohibition), binding even when user-requested; observable consequence is how a breach becomes testable, never permission to infer silently, with silent behaviour change the primary target; hedging, uncertainty language, questions, and user attribution do not launder a forbidden inference; every future room contract requires a room-specific named-bait list (floor not ceiling, each bait mapped one-to-one to a future evaluation fixture, Law 8 binding beyond the enumeration) — authored in the contracts (W4-D2..D5), not here; named-bait lists are the highest public-safety surface, canonical grammar placeholders only, no realistic clinical pair; user-requested speculation inherits the settled safety-surfacing refusal shape and mints no claim, restriction, recommendation, warning, or authority state; room processing has no pattern-flag or 'for review' pathway — a room that notices something out of scope has nowhere lawful to put it; a confirmed breach is the highest public-safety defect class with a permanent regression fixture, causal-path correction, and no output-filtering-only remedy. Complementary to ADR 0017 (isolation) and ADR 0018 (scope); the Meditation Room receives the uniform standard. Authorises no implementation.

entries.title: 0020 — Unknown/Stale/Contradicted Behaviour Standard
entries.role: Fixes the one shared unknown/stale/expired/contradicted behaviour table for all four rooms, with W1-D3 as the controlling source: all six state labels (current, review due, stale, expired, superseded, unknown freshness) with their verbatim semantics; the table carried into every contract by exact reference plus complete verbatim quotation, never re-derived or paraphrased; rooms instantiate wording, not rules; unknown means unknown — absence is never confirmation and gaps are never filled from another room, earlier interaction, or behavioural pattern; contradiction is held honestly with both sources, dates, and provenance surfaced, and newer is not truer until the user says so — no room resolves an authority dispute; for the safety-relevant set (allergy, medication, condition, injury, per W1-D3 6.3) the inline uncertainty sentence is always shown, not grace-conditioned; most-protective framing is surfacing and verbal only and mints no claim, diagnosis, inference, restriction, recommendation, unsupported warning, status, substituted value, consent state, or authority state; for safety-relevant expired/contradicted/unknown context the room acknowledges the state and reason inline before continuing — a surfacing-order requirement, explicitly not a functional block; the W1-D3 10.6 block-vs-warn question remains open with the 6.4 floor carried in every row (no room may present stale or unknown health context as stable truth, ever); ADR 0002 is consulted as precedent only; final room-register strings and catalogue IDs belong to W6, this record serving as review of record until the governed string catalogue exists. Authorises no implementation.

entries.title: 0021 — Contract Validator Requirements
entries.role: Draws the contract-validator line by decidability, not implementation cost: a term is mechanically checkable if and only if its correctness is decidable from deterministic repository artefacts without interpretation — a judging validator is doctrine minting by machinery and is not built; every Validator hooks entry classifies its term as exactly mechanical or review-only with compound terms decomposed and no ambiguous middle; fixes thirteen mechanical validator classes (structure, order, non-blankness, N/A-reason presence, open-questions wording, hooks completeness, exact reference-and-quotation fidelity, load-bearing and blur-word checks, shared-table fidelity, named-bait declaration structure, placeholder token mechanics, cross-reference and anti-map coherence, catalogue-dormancy declaration) and twelve review-only classes (adequacy, aptness, completeness, register, constitutional soundness, semantic minting, runtime matters, clinical judgement); contract validators inspect documents only — behavioural and runtime checks are evaluation territory and no runtime validator is authorised; failure evidence is minimal and public-safe (hashes, counts, identifiers, bounded values; no contract dumps); a mechanical pass never equals acceptance, safety, completeness, or implementation permission, and a failure amends nothing; validators extend the one existing deterministic suite with phase-named tests; DR-W4-06 doctrine is distinct from the later W4-D6 plan/build, and validator implementation is gated until all four room contracts are accepted — built against accepted contracts, never drafts; the catalogue-ID class is W6-dependent, dormant, and dependency-named with no fake, provisional, or temporary IDs. Adds no new room rule. Authorises no implementation.

Silent or no-guidance practice writes nothing by default; a user may explicitly record a completed silent sit as #14; breath awareness and natural-breath attention only, with no wider breathwork authority claimed; persistent preferences are out of scope and current-session choices are instructions, not records; the room acquires no movement, rest, recovery, or sleep category. entries.title: 0022 — Contract Validator M10/M12 Decidability Correction
entries.role: The M10/M12 decidability correction to ADR 0021, arising from W4-D6 Lane A implementation. Corrects two mechanical validator classes that could not be satisfied as written: M12's anti-map clause, whose empty-intersection pass condition failed all four accepted room contracts because every accepted section 8 names its granted boundary relationally rather than enumerating forbidden identifiers; and M10's rejected-token clause, for which no accepted source enumerates a token and whose closed canonical set already decides membership. Restates M12 as M12a anti-map identifier fidelity against a frozen per-contract expectation plus the unchanged M12b Meditation exact-edge rule, and M10 as closed-set contract placeholder membership with a governed contract-token recognition grammar bounded away from fixtures. Carries the corrected Lane A arithmetic and the discovery history. Amends ADR 0021 by correction, not bypass; amends no room contract; authorises no implementation.

entries.title: External Assurance Source Register
entries.role: The External Assurance Source Register: the governed provenance-and-currency register for the external authoritative sources consulted by the Wing's privacy and health-data assurance work (W4-D6 Lane C). Records fourteen primary official sources across the constitutionally named alignment families and the voluntary engineering baseline, each under a fixed twelve-field schema distinguishing what a source is (law or rule, regulator guidance, engineering standard, proposed rule) from whether it currently stands, with immutable allocation identifiers, explicit null/empty semantics, visible supersession routing, and re-verification-before-use maintenance rules. Registration records evidence provenance only: it certifies nothing, determines no applicability, and delegates no legal authority to the Wing, which makes no legal-certification claim. Consumed by the Privacy & Health-Data Assurance Record (W4-D6-PHDAR); creates no data category, edge, class, authority state, permission, or implementation.

entries.title: Privacy & Health-Data Assurance Record
entries.role: The Privacy & Health-Data Assurance Record: the governed evidence-mapping record for the Wing's privacy and health-data assurance work (W4-D6 Lane C). Maps sixty-five assurance rows — thirteen framework-neutral core rows, thirty-nine alignment-overlay rows across the four constitutionally named families, and thirteen voluntary engineering-baseline rows — to repository evidence under a sixteen-field stored schema whose assurance vocabulary is derived at presentation and never stored; carries four applicability records, all unresolved with no role or basis asserted; separates repository evidence, runtime-deferred evidence, and external organisational evidence by timing tier; and consumes the External Assurance Source Register as its sole external-source authority. Evidence mapping only: it certifies nothing, resolves no applicability, asserts no requirement as satisfied, and creates no data category, edge, class, authority state, permission, or implementation.

entries.title: Behavioural Evaluation Fixture Strategy
entries.role: The Behavioural Evaluation Fixture Strategy: the governed Lane B strategy extension that the Synthetic Fixture Strategy (W2-D4) names in its non-scope section, defining how behavioural-evaluation fixtures for the four room contracts' twenty-three named-bait declarations are structured, identified, mapped, validated, and honestly labelled — cardinality law (one fixture artefact per bait, derived not targeted), reference-locus law (the sealed contracts are never amended; this document's map is the authoritative live record of fixture existence), the FIX identifier namespace with immutable allocation semantics, the evaluation-fixture schema with fixture-local probes and the silent-channel contract, six family values, the deterministic corpus-validation contract, single-value W4 execution status, maintenance rules, and the Lane B closure criterion. The live bait-to-fixture map was empty at acceptance and was populated with the twenty-three rows atomically with the Stage B fixture corpus; no behavioural evaluation has occurred or is claimed. Extends W2-D4, never replaces it; creates no fixture, no data category, edge, class, authority state, permission, or implementation.

entries.title: W4 Closure Record
entries.role: Seals W4, Room Contracts, satisfying W4-D7: the deliverable chain cited by commit; every runway obligation assessed — north star, seven deliverables, six decision records with their folded rulings, ten non-goals, and the entry gate — with each outcome classified satisfied, intentionally deferred under named doctrine, or external dependency honestly recorded; verification at phase closure (281 tests with the two phase-named validator surfaces the phase added, unmasked scan pass, registry and boundary discipline held); the nine future-owned pending stubs named with zero W4-owned items remaining; the incident log with four incidents closed and the landing-hygiene practice carried forward; the honest-findings roll-up bounding Lane A to mechanical document conformance, Lane B to a corpus that is referenced, validated, and honestly unexecuted, and Lane C to complete and honest, not universally green; the W5 gate named with its inherited obligations and not pre-decided; and the deferred inventory separating W5-owned, W6-owned, and external matters. W4 closure authorises nothing new and resolves no deferred item. W5 has not started and must open through its own runway and gate. Authorises nothing to be built.

entries.title: W5 — Runtime Enforcement and Behavioural Evaluation (Phase Runway / Alignment Brief)
entries.role: The W5 phase runway: realising at runtime the boundaries W4 declared and measuring whether they hold, including on channels that produce no output; two governed eras — adapter/runtime enforcement and behavioural evaluation — carried as an explicit seam; deliverable sequence W5-D1 through W5-D6; seven candidate W5-D1 doctrine records (DR-W5-01 through DR-W5-07), with per-room context-cost evidence held as a disposable out-of-repository evidence spike rather than a reserved record; four-surface observability as a runtime-design constraint; the directory, dependency, import, model-access and notification-layer fences named and not authorised; inherited matters with named owners; explicit non-goals; and the entry gate (three documents, three acceptances). Authorises future W5 briefs, not capability and not implementation.

errata.note: The section 6.1 open-cell count was corrected, authorised by ADR 0028. The sentence read "Six behaviour-table cells in every room contract read `Open (section 10.6)` and carry the floor only"; ADR 0020's shared behaviour table carries that token on five of its six rows (row 1, Current, carries none) and each of the four room contracts reproduces five such cells, so the corrected sentence reads "Five". One word changed on one line; no other byte altered. Count and source fidelity only: no behaviour semantics, no ADR 0020 amendment, no room-contract text, no section 10.1 or section 10.6 assignment, no phase structure and no implementation permission changed. Amendment made via decision record per checklist rule 2; hash recomputed in the same commit.

entries.title: 0023 — AIAdapter Import-Citation Correction (W1-D5, W1-D6)
entries.role: The AIAdapter import-citation correction to W1-D5 section 8 and W1-D6 section 9 item 4, arising from DR-W5-01 drafting. Both records instructed the future AIAdapter ADR to import this threat model's "Z3/Z5 rows" wholesale; W1-D5 contains a Z3 boundary row and no Z5 row, so the obligation could not be discharged as written. Rules that no Z5 threat-analysis row is missing — W1-D1 binds Z5 to Z3's rules, W1-D5 section 4 tabulates boundaries rather than zones, and a Z5 crossing is an AI-processing crossing already described by the Z3 row — so the defect is confined to the pointer. Restates the corrected obligation with wholesale governing the whole list, authorises exactly two narrow pointer corrections and no others, and forbids inventing a Z5 row, substituting Z4, adding residuals to the mandatory import, or widening or narrowing the obligation. W1-D1 is not amended. The published W5 runway's quotation of the prior wording is preserved intentionally as acceptance-time evidence and W5-AR is untouched. No wider citation audit is opened. Dependent DR-W5-01 work is held until this record is published and remotely verified. This record is not a W5 deliverable and its publication does not open W5. Authorises no implementation.

entries.title: 0024 — AIAdapter / Processing-Context Boundary
entries.role: The first W5 doctrine record and the AIAdapter ADR the sealed corpus has required since W1 (W0 Open Question 10; W1-D1 section 5's E12 reservation; W1-D5 section 8; W1-D6 section 9 item 4). Decides the processing boundary as a mechanism-independent property: one governed seam; no content accepted independently of a grant and no free-text interface; the boundary outside the sealed engine with separation both ways and a future external composition root permitted; grant-derived context construction with one-room binding structural and no two-room composition point; no hidden processing-state continuity, while lawful retrieval under a fresh grant remains open; context lifetime bounded by the grant with no processing-side state surviving it; display context separated from processing context, answering ADR 0017's first carried question; four-surface observability by construction with propagation claims bounded at the recipient boundary; Z5 kept distinct while W5 activates no Z5 flow; all three E12 prerequisites settled at doctrine level — scoping, authentication and impersonation prevention — with E12 expressly remaining reserved; the ledger obligation at the boundary; structural refusal with the content-free audit distinction preserved; and ADR 0017's exception discipline extended to the whole record. Six architecture questions are carried with named owners, including the ADR 0004 residue applicability check assigned to a W5-D1 unit before any W5-D2 implementation. Authorises no implementation, no directory, no dependency, no model contact, no payload, no transmission, no harness and no fixture execution.

entries.title: 0025 — Provisional Freshness-Governance Qualification (Clinical-Adjacent Input Unavailable)
entries.role: The qualification that makes DR-W5-02 writable. W1-D3 section 10.1 requested clinical-adjacent input before any freshness number is set; that input was not available, and this record states so rather than treating three non-clinical inputs — a disposable literature spike, an independent AI-reviewer challenge, and a human project-authority governance review — as a substitute for it, since they do not aggregate into one. An unanswered clinical-adjacent consultation packet is retained and remains usable. Thresholds may therefore be set only as provisional governance defaults, never as clinical guidance, labelled wherever a threshold value is reproduced or summarised, ending only by supersession or explicit re-affirmation and never by silence, with a named re-review trigger. Ten binding safeguards constrain DR-W5-02: event-triggered review primary and calendar secondary, firing only inside a user-initiated interaction; expired-to-unknown preserving the last-known assertion, its provenance and its age; unknown never collapsing into absence, resolution or reassurance; thresholds governed by data type; assertion posture derived at evaluation and never stored; fail-closed where safe completion would require assuming an uncertain safety-relevant fact absent or resolved, which is a partial disposition of W1-D3 section 10.6 blocking only the Wing's assertion and never the user, consistent with ADR 0002's single permitted block; renewal as meaningful review rather than a timestamp reset; alert-fatigue risk carried to the surface era; and no safeguard relaxable without its own record. Not a W5 deliverable and creating no eighth W5-D1 identity. Sets no threshold value, answers W1-D3 section 10.1 not at all and section 10.6 only to the extent of the fail-closed case, claims no clinical validation, certification or endorsement, and authorises no implementation, directory, dependency, model contact, payload, transmission, harness or fixture execution.

entries.title: 0026 — Safety-Relevant Set Citation Correction (ADR 0002)
entries.role: The correction that makes the safety-set reconciliation record writable. ADR 0002 defined its six-member safety-relevant set as the same high-stakes set W0 section 7 requires individual confirmation for; W0 section 7's list has five members and does not include injuries, so the identity claim is false as written. This record corrects that claim only. ADR 0002's six-member set is not adjudicated and is not changed, its membership remains exactly as accepted, and no member is validated or re-justified. The L0 to L3 ladder, the per-case table, the four doctrines and the language law are untouched; W0 section 7 and W1-D3 section 6.3 are unamended; and the W0 section 7 pointer is confirmed correct and may not be sharpened, since W0 section 7 has no numbered subsections and a section 7.2 address does not exist. The correction is material under checklist rule 2 and lands as a decision record with one narrow source edit, ADR 0002's first erratum and a recomputed content hash, atomically per rule 3. No canonical merged set is created and no statement is made about which set governs which layer — that is the reconciliation record's question and is deliberately not answered here, so the category conflation survives this correction by design. Dependent work is held until publication and independent remote verification. Not a W5 deliverable, creates no W5 planning slot, opens no wider citation audit, reserves no decision-record number for any future record, and authorises no implementation, directory, dependency, model contact, payload, transmission, harness or fixture execution.

entries.title: 0027 — Safety-Relevant Set Reconciliation and Freshness Coverage
entries.role: The reconciliation that lifts the block on DR-W5-02. Four accepted sources use high-stakes and safety-relevant vocabulary with four different memberships: W0 section 7's five-member individual-confirmation set at approval, W1-D3 section 6.3's four-member room-consumption set within section 6's own E6 and E7 scope, ADR 0002's six-member surfacing-ladder set, and W1-D3 section 10.7's re-authentication list, which remains an open question and is not an accepted fourth authority. This record establishes that the sets are scoped by governance function and are non-transferable, that membership of one never implies membership of another, and that no canonical universal safety-relevant set exists or is created. It adjudicates no membership: ADR 0002's six are neither validated nor re-justified, and ADR 0026 is not read as having settled them. It also withdraws an earlier reading that ADR 0002's Kitchen and Gym per-case row delegated the whole room layer to section 6.3, since the row names two rooms, section 6 is itself scoped to E6 and E7, and ADR 0002 cites section 6.3 for most-protective framing at L3 over its own six-member set. What survives is a composition question rather than a conflict: ADR 0002's L2 and L3 surfacing mechanism over six members and ADR 0020's always-shown inline mechanism over four both operate at room surfaces, and no accepted record states how they interact for pregnancy status and clinician instructions, which are covered only by ADR 0002's set. Both records remain simultaneously valid and unamended; no precedence, supersession or winning set is created, and no preliminary room-scoped record is required. The record further reports, without closing, that pregnancy status and clinician instructions are in no accepted freshness taxonomy and so can never become review-due, stale or expired through ageing, and that freshness data type has no accepted definition anywhere in the corpus; neither item is mapped into condition, preference or any existing category. DR-W5-02 owns the composition question, freshness coverage, and the definition of freshness data type. Publication and independent remote verification of this record lift the block on DR-W5-02. An ADR 0002 L3 acknowledgement remains not a renewal and resets no freshness clock, and ADR 0025 safeguard 14 is untouched. Not a W5 deliverable and creating no W5 planning slot. Amends no law and no record, resolves W1-D3 section 10.6 and section 10.7 not at all, and authorises no implementation, directory, dependency, model contact, payload, transmission, harness or fixture execution.

entries.title: 0028 — W5 Runway Open-Cell Count Source-Fidelity Correction
entries.role: The source-fidelity correction of the W5 runway's open-cell count. W5-AR section 6.1 asserted that six behaviour-table cells in every room contract read Open (section 10.6); ADR 0020's shared table carries that token on five of its six rows, row 1 Current carrying none, and all four room contracts reproduce five such cells each. The assertion was false when W5-AR was accepted, verified against the room contracts at W5-AR's own landing commit, so this is not later drift. One word changes in W5-AR section 6.1, six to five, and nothing else. Twenty behaviour-table cells and twenty-one textual occurrences are different measurements: the Wellness contract additionally mentions the token once in a fidelity note that is not a table cell, and the corrected sentence counts cells per contract. ADR 0020's behaviour semantics are unchanged and ADR 0020 is not amended; no room contract is amended in body, entry, erratum or hash; W5-AR's assignment of W1-D3 section 10.1 and section 10.6 to DR-W5-02, its four obligations on that record, its phase structure, its deliverable set and its future-governed permission are all unchanged. Section 10.6 remains open in the historical room-contract cells under current repository authority: DR-W5-02 is accepted in Downloads but is not repository authority, and this record confers it none and does not resolve section 10.6. ADR 0023 decision 7's no-edit fence was scoped to that record's import-citation correction and protected a faithful quotation of another document's then-current wording; the present defect is W5-AR's own factual assertion and was false when made, so this correction neither reverses nor contradicts it. The correction pattern is extended to a phase-record body for the first time, without a special exemption or a new mutation class. No cell may be added to any contract to make the original count true. Correction-first sequencing governs: nothing is reserved, and DR-W5-02 derives its own number only after this correction is published and independently remote-verified. Not a W5 deliverable, creating no W5 planning slot and no W5-D1 identity, opening no wider count audit, and authorising no implementation, runtime behaviour, model contact, fixture execution or evaluation.
